name: Aetherbreak
description:
About This Game

In this fast-paced, 3D first-person platformer, soar through the air as Velos, an angel attempting to prove his worth and break free from the aether by overcoming a gauntlet of challenges. Players speed across platforms, navigating obstacles and dodging hazards as quickly as possible in order to escape purgatory and help Velos earn his wings. 

Unlock various tools on your journey- like grappling hooks, potions, knives- which will help you navigate each level. See if you can clear each stage fast enough in this strange new world.

Aetherbreak features a practice mode for each level, so you can re-run a stage as many times as you want, using checkpoints and timed runs.

Features Include:

  • Dynamic Levels: Test your skills as you face traverse challenging levels, utilizing four different abilities and maneuvering through obstacles! 

  • Practice Mode: Hone your abilities and master tricky sections of levels to complete your runs faster!

  • Scored runs: Replay levels and try to beat your old scores!

  • Power ups: Find power ups throughout each level that will help you clear each stage.
